note: The owner's store photos (2026-11-09). Colour and tone graded; upscaled 2x with Topaz High Fidelity V2. Three are retouched with AI (see edit), one of them (the hero) relit to golden hour. The originals stay private: one shows customers.

storefront.alt: The Flavors Detroit store in daylight: a black cloud-shaped sign reading Flavors Detroit 5700 on a blue corrugated tower above a dark grey building, its black awning reading Flavors Detroit and Recreational Cannabis, a lit Open sign and a Cannabis feather flag with a green cross, with traffic lights hanging over the street.
storefront.edit: The car dashboard, phone mount and a wiper streak in the original phone photo were removed and the street below filled in with AI (fal FLUX.1 [pro] Fill inside a mask; a curb spot and the streak over a small far-left sign re-filled with fal Bria Eraser); every other pixel is the photo. Upscaled 2x (Topaz High Fidelity V2) and colour graded.

hero.alt: The Flavors Detroit store at golden hour: the black cloud-shaped sign reading Flavors Detroit 5700 on its blue corrugated tower, the dark building with its black awning reading Flavors Detroit and Recreational Cannabis, a lit Open sign and a Cannabis feather flag, under a warm evening sky.
hero.edit: The storefront photo (car dashboard removed as above) relit to golden hour with AI (fal Nano Banana Pro).
